emptyState.heading: Project gallery coming soon
emptyState.body: We're building out the project gallery from our before-and-after photo discipline — every job ends with photos sent to the homeowner, and we're working through which ones to feature here. In the meantime, the photo gallery on the home page is a snapshot of recent work. Want to see something specific? Call (913) 555-0177.

cta.heading: Looking for a similar project?
cta.body: Most projects we feature came from a homeowner who saw a previous one and asked if we could do something similar. Tell us what caught your eye and we'll let you know if it's something we can match.
